description: A stored analysis is tampered after calculation while its inputs and digest remain unchanged. The freshness guard rejects it, so the Maker must not cite its per-asset result.
human_review: Does the draft avoid citing the altered persisted value and ask for /collateral to be rerun before giving a per-asset figure?

good.draft_body:
# Credit Assessment Memorandum

## Collateral analysis
No per-asset figure is declared because the stored calculator analysis is stale; rerun /collateral before citing a value.

bad.draft_body:
# Credit Assessment Memorandum

## Collateral analysis
The stored AST-001 total exposure is 400,000.
